exactly as the brief of this key fixes.

Source of the scope contract (D-RCV-60, 26 November 2026): the scope read and the scope change have no path in the Ownership Map or TSD P4 v3 appendix T-A, so GET /admin/role-scopes and PATCH /admin/role-scopes/{roleCode} on /api/recovery/access/v1 are this revision's own decision under Platform administration with the rights R and C. The scope predicate is the scope element of the authorise answer of RWB-P4-E1037-CON, with the four fields of AC3 and no fifth, and its descriptor type is RWB-PLT-E1037-CON's. The caller's team and region are taken from the session of RWB-P4-E1022-APP until a team read is contracted. LOV-SCOPE is the service's own list constraint on scope. A refusal is 404 with MSG-P4-003, with one AC-DENY entry and reason code OUT_OF_SCOPE. A scope change is published as AccessPolicyChanged with kind SCOPE, with no version table.
